item.title: A system overview for near-term, low-trust AI compute verification
item.description: A working draft proposing a privacy-preserving, retrofittable architecture for verifying AI compute under an arms-control-style agreement between rival states. It separates evidence capture (network taps) from evaluation in secure audit environments, so compliance can be checked without mutually trusted silicon or exposing confidential data.

item.title: Off-Chip Compute Verification
